messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — scheduling a staggered canary deploy for v2.8.1 tomorrow 10:00 PT (17:00 UTC). Who can own deploy/rollback and run smoke checks? Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with ~10m wait between steps. Feature flag is ready to flip. Rollback plan: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-v2`.

devon: I can own the deploy and smoke runs. Oncall that window. Will post metrics live and do rollback if anything looks off.

samir: Infra is green. No DB migrations in this release. Build artifact pinned: `v2.8.1-rc3`. I'll warm caches before full rollout.

tia: CS will staff the queue. Preparing canned responses and escalation matrix.

anna: Marketing — aiming for a soft announcement at 11:30 PT. If rollout slips >30m, tell me so we can delay copy.

maria: Smoke command to run: `./ops/smoke_check.sh --endpoints /api/health /v1/generate --rps 5` . If canary fails at any stage -> rollback immediately and post results (✅ / ❌) here.

devon: Copy. Where's the runbook and rollback snippets?

maria: Runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/deploy-v2. Rollback snippet: ```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/api-v2
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/api-v2
``` 

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created by maria: 2025-11-12T17:00:00Z -> 2025-11-12T18:00:00Z. Canary policy: 10/50/100. Job id: 6732.

support-ops: Support coverage confirmed for the window. Triage playbook linked in the runbook.

samir: Reminder: warm KV caches after canary flip: `curl -X POST https://canary-01/api/warm-cache` — I’ll run this once 10% is healthy.

devon: I'll do warm + smoke. Ping me when you flip the flag @devon.

tia: CS note: if we see >0.5% error rate or repeated 5xx, escalate to oncall and open #incident-deploy-v281.

anna: For marketing: if we hit the 50% step with <0.3% error and p95 < 300ms, I want the green light to proceed with the banner.

maria: Agreed. Key metrics to watch: request_error_rate, gen_p95, token_throughput. Thresholds in runbook.

devon: I'll post structured updates like `10:00 canary -> ✅ 0.2% err, p95 240ms`. If I see problems I'll post `ROLLBACK` with a 1-line reason.

samir: Infra is on standby. I'll tail logs: `kubectl logs -f deployment/api-v2 -n inference` and watch for GC spikes.

support-ops: Creating channel #incident-deploy-v281 now, will invite triage rotation.

tia: :thumbsup: canned replies ready, escalation matrix uploaded to runbook.

anna: Good luck everyone :rocket:

maria: Final checklist: deploy owner = @devon, infra telemetry = @samir, CS lead = @tia, comms = @anna. If anyone can't make it, shout now.

devon: All set. Kicking at 10:00 PT (17:00 UTC). Will update every step.

samir: I'll start cache warm after 10% stable, then confirm.

support-ops: Triage team standing by. I'll update if we need additional headcount.

maria: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source of truth during the rollout. Post final go/no-go 15m before window.
